35:45.text: And if Allâh were to punish men for that which they earned, He would not leave a moving
creature on the surface of the earth; but He gives them respite to an appointed term: and when their term comes, then verily, Allâh is Ever All-Seer of His slaves.

36:2.text: By the Qur’ân, full of wisdom
(i.e. full of laws, evidence, and proofs)

36:4.text: (i.e. on Allâh’s religion of Islâmic Monotheism)

36:5.text: sent down by the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful,

36:6.text: In order that you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are heedless.

36:7.text: has proved true against most of them, so they will not believe.

36:8.text: Verily We have put on their necks iron collars reaching to the chins, so that their heads are raised up.

36:9.text: And We have put a barrier before them, and a barrier behind them, and We have covered them up, so that they cannot see.

36:10.text: It is the same to them whether you warn them or you warn them not, they will not believe.

36:11.text: You can only warn him who follows the Reminder
unseen. Bear you to such one the glad tidings of forgiveness, and a generous reward

36:12.text: Verily, We give life to the dead, and We record that which they send before
and all things We have recorded with numbers
